_provenance.what_is_real: Block 47079437 (0x2cf260d) is a real Base block: it is the block of the transaction in crates/apex-chain/tests/fixtures/base_receipt.json, which forge recorded at deploy time and whose source run file (broadcast/Deploy.s.sol/8453/run-1781049614240.json) is tracked in git. The observed_at timestamps derive from that recording's recorded_at_unix. The two following block heights are that block's successors.
_provenance.what_is_constructed: The fingerprints, the venue state versions and the swap target are constructed. This is NOT a capture of a live Base state feed -- capturing one is Task 8.5's 14-day shadow run, and this file is the shape that run replaces.
_provenance.why_a_file_and_not_a_literal: Task 8.5 has to replay real traffic through the same plane. A stream expressed as a Rust literal could not be swapped for a real capture without rewriting whatever asserts against it; a file can be.
_provenance.the_duplicate_is_deliberate: Events 2 and 3 are byte-identical. A websocket reconnect replays, and §5.6's feed arbiter exists because more than one source is watched. tests/end_to_end.rs replays the pair concurrently, which is the case §17.4's suppression is about.
_provenance.schema_note: Task 2b.1 moved StateEvent to apex-state and gave EventKind §12.4's eight template classes. PendingSwap now carries the pools it touched -- which is what the frontier revalues on -- and the notional, because the census that found the edge triggered on swaps >= $5,000 and a threshold baked into a type is a threshold nobody can change.
